Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

SIRALOP

"Siralop"

[Verse 1]

Three days passed

The council did not sleep

(the council does not sleep)

(but they were working)

(the fragment lay open on the table)

(they made adjustments)

[Spoken]

[Asala:] It is done

[Basala:] We have fixed it

[Carala:] And made some adjustments

[Darlala:] Small ones

[Ebala:] Necessary ones

[Farala:] You will go home now

[Cassie:] How

[Asala:] Polaris

[Asala:] We use the pull of Polaris

[Asala:] It will bring you to Level twenty-four

[Asala:] Your correct time

[Pre-Chorus]

Polaris

The north star

The fixed point

The one that does not move

They would use its pull

To pull them home

[Chorus]

Siralop

Polaris backwards

The star reversed to send us back

We go home

We go to where we belong

The pull of the north star

Carries us

Siralop

[Verse 2]

But first

The goodbyes

[Spoken]

[Cassie:] We should say goodbye to Yeshaw

(they found him at the table)

(he had not left the table)

(there were many bowls)

[Chaos:] Thank you for the reign

[Yeshaw:] It is only three days in

[Chaos:] That is more than most manage

[Yeshaw:] The soup helps

[Crotus:] There is more where that came from

(Crotus had been cooking for three days straight)

(there was a very large batch of soup)

(he had not been asked to do this)

(he had simply done it)

[Crotus:] For the road

[Yeshaw:] This is… a lot of soup

[Crotus:] It is the right amount

[Crotus:] The pepper makes it better

(young Yeshaw looked at the batch)

(it would last him a very long time)

(he did not fully understand yet)

(but something in him held onto it)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Then the Mothman arrived

Out of nowhere

(the way the Mothman always arrives)

(he did not explain)

(he never explains)

[Spoken]

[The Mothman said nothing]

[He opened his wings]

[He had brought peppers]

(A LOT of peppers)

(more peppers than a star should need)

(more peppers than any soup could hold)

(he had brought A LOT)

[Yeshaw:] …

[Yeshaw:] For the soup

[The Mothman:] (he nodded)

(he had understood the assignment)

[Chorus 2]

Siralop

Polaris backwards

The star reversed to send us back

The soup for the road

The peppers for the soup

The kindness of strange creatures

Who show up without explaining

Siralop

[Bridge]

They said goodbye to Yeshaw

He was the one now

He would be the one for a very long time

(he did not know yet what he would carry)

(he did not know yet what the soup was for)

(young Yeshaw looked at them)

(he looked at the crew)

(he looked at the soup)

(he looked at the peppers)

(something rose in him)

(his constellation)

(he would not show it)

[Spoken]

[Yeshaw:] Travel well

[Yeshaw:] Come back

[Yeshaw:] If you can

(he did not say what he felt)

(his constellation would not let him)

(the feelings were there)

(he held them)

(he would hold them a long time)

They said goodbye to the council

The council said nothing back

(the council does not say goodbye)

(the council simply stops being in the room)

(and then is in the next room)

(and then is somewhere else)

(this is how the council travels)

[Pre-Chorus 3]

They used the fragment

The fixed fragment

The adjusted fragment

Polaris pulled

The pull was strong

The pull was home

[Final Chorus - key lift]

Polaris

The pull of the north star

Carries us home

Level twenty-four

Our correct time

We are back

We are where we belong

Polaris

[Outro]

Level twenty-four

They arrived

The air was wrong

(it was quiet)

(it was too quiet)

(the crew looked up)

Polaris

The fixed point

The star that does not move

Polaris was not glowing

(Persy said nothing)

(Rion said nothing)

(Cassie said nothing)

(they all looked up)

(at where the light should be)

(and was not)

Siralop

Polaris backwards

The star that held on

Held on

Held on

— and was not glowing
